original.scope: Shipped native menu bindings and action selector names only. No original zoom routine was executed; numeric steps, bounds and persistence behavior are not established by this resource.

flutter.viewport: Navigator and overlays are laid out at window size divided by scale and painted through FittedBox. MediaQuery dimensions and insets use that viewport; devicePixelRatio includes the scale.
flutter.policy: Browser-style presets within an app-selected 50–200% range; no numeric equivalence claim with the original.
flutter.native_window_controls: Their physical inset is preserved; sidebar drags convert screen distances to the scaled viewport.

verification.tests: flutter test --no-pub test/app_scale_test.dart: 2 passed; the same zoom tests failed against the previous app root for unchanged control sizes.
verification.drag_regression: At 50%, a 30-point drag previously moved the sidebar 15 points; it now moves 30 points.
verification.live: A macOS debug SpotifyDesktopApp probe was hot reloaded and restarted. Command key-message dispatch produced 48 -> 52.8 and 48 -> 43.2 point Home controls at 110% and 90%; reset restored 48. A scaled pointer click opened a dialog; zoom and reset worked with that route present. No runtime errors were reported.
verification.live_limit: OS key injection could not run while the macOS session was locked. Debug key dispatch and explicit probe frames were used.
verification.existing_shell_failure: The broader app_shell_test.dart suite reports sidebar Semantics increasedValue assertions. Its unconnected-root test was rerun without the zoom root and reproduced the same Semantics assertion.
